body: Quick pass (UMA) @ ab0f88fa: quick gate green on the final head (motion, app, ui; 12.1 min), clippy clean, 3 external goldens added, none moved, body complete. Kept as a DRAFT on purpose: stacked on #1045 (on #1005); merges at the cut with #1005.
M5 is refreshing this PR with main (its author session has been idle)

M5 stopped refreshing this PR (nothing pushed). The textual conflicts resolve cleanly (generate.rs: the geom/holder/cutter block moved to the top of the job in main, so the `thread_op::root_cutter` line goes after it; Tool literals need both `pitch_min` and main's `turning`; ui mod.rs/pages.rs keep both). But after the merge main's #1000/#1096 guard `solid_law_goldens::every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes` fails on this PR's new posted goldens: `thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc` (and the stacked `thread_mill_m8_multi_form.nc`) are posted but no gate judges their program. Fix needs a decision from the author: judge them in `verdicts()`/`posted_gates`, or name them in `UNJUDGED` with a reason. Also `crates/tools/src/thread_mill.rs` and `tests/recorded_post_streams.rs` need the other side's new Tool field.

This conflicts with main (37d93ae5). Please `git merge upstream/main` (NeoTech/Camcraft main) into the branch and push. Conflicting files: crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs plus the golden/test lists (golden_cl.rs, mill2d_b/c, operations.rs, solid_law_goldens.rs, drilling/tests.rs, center_cut_owed.rs, ui mod/pages) - ~10 hunks of both-sides test moves around a generate.rs change; merge main and re-apply.

Merged the refreshed parent #1045 (`issue/992-thread-undrilled` @ d43ccb43, which carries #1005 and upstream/main) into this branch to resolve conflicts; `upstream/main` merged on top was already up to date. New head: d82a8061.

**Conflicts and resolutions**
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, Thread arm: kept both. External (`*external`) keeps #985's own law, `thread_boss::crest_region` on the boss's minor circle with no silhouette, and `thread_round` stays true for it. Internal: `region_for_job`, then #1205's `walls_round` gate on `thread_op::crest_region`, exactly as the parent has it. The undrilled-hole law (`thread_entry::judge`) for holes and `judge_bosses` for bosses are both kept.
- `crates/app/src/operation/thread_op.rs`, `root_cutter`: kept both. It now takes `round: bool` (#1205), so a non-round hole's teeth are judged at full radius. It also narrows by `depth_of(p, external)` (#985). The doc comment now covers both, and the external unit test passes `round = true`.
- `crates/app/tests/hole_wall_flats.rs` (auto-merged, did not compile): added `external: false` to its Thread params.

No refusal was dropped. The round-wall and undrilled rules for internal threads are unchanged.

**Follow-up in this push** (`test(thread)` commit d82a8061): the chain's posted-golden guard (`every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes`) now judges this PR's new `nc/thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc`. `posted_gates/thread.rs` has an `external_verdict()`. It regenerates the golden on the stud fixture, with the stock cleared round the boss by the roughing ahead, and checks that the result is byte-identical to the CL golden. It then runs the generator's blocking laws and the post's verification gate, and both pass with no blocking findings. `the_thread_golden_passes_its_gate` asserts both thread goldens are judged. The stud world builders moved from `thread_boss.rs` to `thread_support::boss` so the two suites share them.

`git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the thread chain's files (#1005, #1045, #1137).

**Gate:** `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green: tools 4s, sim 12s, motion 145s, app 793s, ui 89s. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

Open question for review, not changed here: #1205's round-wall test is applied to holes only. A polygonal boss (a hex stud) gets no equivalent, so its crest law reads the minor circle as before.

The PR stays a draft and is still stacked on #1045.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
